about: The LiveWell Academy: ten programs that take a reader from never having opened the Bible to reading it well, knowing what the church believes and why, and living it. Each program is a few tracks in order; each track is a few sessions of about ten minutes. It is free, it is kept on your device, and its certificates are unaccredited.

programs.title: Exploring Christianity
programs.reader: Not sure any of it is true? Start here.
programs.outcome: You will be able to say what Christians actually claim about Jesus, weigh the evidence for and against, and give the strongest objections a fair hearing.

programs.title: New to Faith
programs.reader: Just started following Jesus, or coming back? Start here.
programs.outcome: You will know the gospel well enough to explain it, have the habits of prayer and Bible reading in place, and know what to do when you fail or doubt.

programs.title: The Bible's Big Story
programs.reader: Never read the Bible, or only in pieces? Start here.
programs.outcome: You will be able to tell the whole Bible as one story, from creation to new creation, and place any book or passage inside it.

programs.title: How to Study the Bible
programs.reader: Want to read a passage for yourself and understand it?
programs.outcome: You will be able to study any passage on your own: observe it, read it as the kind of writing it is, place it in its world, follow its words, and apply it honestly.

programs.title: Deep in One Book
programs.reader: Ready to know one book of the Bible well?
programs.outcome: You will have read five books of the Bible closely, chapter by chapter, from the first story of Genesis to Paul's letter to the Romans.

programs.title: What Christians Believe
programs.reader: Want to know what the church has always believed, and why?
programs.outcome: You will be able to explain the creed line by line, trace each core doctrine to Scripture, and state the views on contested questions fairly.

programs.title: Church History
programs.reader: Want to know how we got here?
programs.outcome: You will know the church's story across two thousand years, its councils, its failures and its renewals, and how each age read the Bible.

programs.title: Faith for Teenagers
programs.reader: Thirteen to eighteen? This is yours.
programs.outcome: You will have weighed whether it is true, seen the Bible's whole story, and thought hard about who you are and how to live it now.

programs.title: Living It
programs.reader: Want the faith to carry the weight of an ordinary week?
programs.outcome: You will have brought Scripture to bear on marriage, work, money, rest, grief and forgiveness, with the church's long wisdom beside you.

programs.title: Faith at Home
programs.reader: Leading a family? Start at the table.
programs.outcome: You will have a way to lead faith at home that fits your children's ages, answers their hard questions honestly, and follows the church's year together.
